simple.meaning: כָּוָה (kâvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to prick or penetrate ; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כָּוָה (H3554) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 6:28, with occurrences in Proverbs, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּוָה (H3554) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כָּוָה (H3554) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כָּוָה (kâvâh) / H3554 is traced through Proverbs 6:28, Isaiah 43:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: properly, to prick or penetrate ; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into)
definitions.full: H3554. kavah [ כָּוָה ] verb burn, scorch, brand (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic especially Pa`el; Arabic cauterize ) — Niph`al Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּכָּוֶה Isa 43:2 thou shalt not be scorched (figurative of Israel, || בָּעַר ); 3 feminine plural תִּכָּוֶי֑נָה לֹא וְרַגְלָיו Prov 6:28 shall a man walk on the coals and his feet not be burned ? (|| שָׂרַף of garments 6:27 ).
